value.message: Halton Hills Public Library's Acton branch runs Kids & Me, a free drop-in for families with babies to age 6, Thursdays 10:30am-12pm - their site says. Links2Care also runs EarlyON drop-in programs for 0-6 year olds at Acton and Georgetown, though I couldn't get into their pages today for times. I'll keep watching and text you what they say.
